notes: Elbow locked, palm facing your thigh: swing the straight arm forward and back like a pendulum, 3 times, fast. Same plane as a curl, no sideways motion.

Count out loud: 11 lifts. Lifts 2 and 4: lift only until your forearm is level, then lower. Lifts 5 and 9: lower only until your forearm is level, then start the next lift. Lift 7: after it, lower all the way and let the arm hang still for 10 s (count it out loud), then carry on. All other lifts: full and strict.
Count out loud: 6 lifts. Lifts 3, 4 and 5: let your elbow swing forward as you lift, then bring it back. All other lifts: full and strict.

Count out loud: 11 lifts. Lifts 6, 7 and 10: let your elbow swing forward as you lift, then bring it back. Lift 3: after it, lower all the way and let the arm hang still for 15 s (count it out loud), then carry on. All other lifts: full and strict.
Count out loud: 6 lifts. All full and strict.
Count out loud: 13 lifts. Lift 4: lift only until your forearm is level, then lower. Lift 6: hold 2–3 s halfway up, then finish it. All other lifts: full and strict.
Put the dumbbell down and pick it up again, three times. Not a set.
Shake out your arm and fiddle with the strap for about 15 s, without moving the band. Not a set.
Slow: 3 s up, 3 s down. Count out loud: 7 lifts. Lift 5: after it, lower all the way and let the arm hang still for 10 s (count it out loud), then carry on. All other lifts: full and strict.
Alternate arms; count only the sensor arm's lifts. Count out loud: 9 lifts. Lift 5: lift only until your forearm is level, then lower. All other lifts: full and strict.
Fast: as fast as you can while staying in control. Count out loud: 7 lifts. All full and strict.

Count out loud: 16 lifts. Lifts 11 and 15: lift only until your forearm is level, then lower. Lifts 3 and 6: lower only until your forearm is level, then start the next lift. All other lifts: full and strict.
Walk around for about 15 s, arms natural. Not a set: the counter should say 0.
Curl until you can't do one more full rep. Count full reps only and TYPE that count at the prompt (Enter would record 0).
Same pendulum swings: elbow locked, palm facing your thigh, forward and back only.
